n01.text: New career expands in place into two choices. 'Start in 2017' is today's Act I start ($10K, empty garage). Prologue saves carry a 'Prologue' tag in the load list.

n02.text: Copy is a 3-line placeholder paraphrase; the final text comes from text_prologue.en.json. The button is the only way on, so there is no skip.

n03a.text: Solo odds = your share of network hashrate × blocks per week: 784 MH/s ÷ 494 GH/s ≈ 0.16% × 1,008 ≈ 1.6 blocks. Pool ≈ 0.16% × 1,008 × 50 BTC ≈ 80, less the 2% fee ≈ 78 BTC.

n03b.text: Household meter: load against the 1.44 kW cap of living at home. Patience falls while load stays high; low patience triggers household cards (the bill, heat, noise). Moving out ends the cap and the free power.

n03c.text: Offers tray: at most 2 waiting cards. Proposal to confirm: unanswered offers expire at quarter end. The Coins panel's Move takes one week, since coins must sit on an exchange to be sold.

n03d.text: Conflict to settle: the brief's sample offer is a 'Conference invitation (2011)', but life.json only has conferences in 2013Q2 and 2014Q2. Drawn as the brief says; either add a 2011 event to life.json or change the sample offer.

n04a.text: Each card shows ~2 s per skipped quarter. Prices and difficulty changes come from market_quarterly_prologue.csv; the 'mined' figures for Q1 and Q2 2012 are illustrative (Q3 2012 is the brief's example). The Q4 2012 halving and pre-order window make it the natural interrupt.

n04b.text: Interrupt: when an event fires during auto-play, the card stops and the event card opens over it. 'Pause here' turns the next quarter into a full Plan phase.

n05a.text: Selling limit: a share of real exchange volume that quarter (doc 23). The 1,850 BTC figure is the brief's sample. Proposal: the price-impact warning appears as the sell amount nears the limit.

n05b.text: The lost-coins row is an illustrative example (a pre-backup key loss). No scripted exchange loss has happened by Q2 2011; the Jun 2011 hack and the Feb 2014 collapse would add rows here.

n06a.text: Conflict, source wins: the brief says 'promised delivery Q1 2013', but preorders.json opens the group buy only in 2013Q1 and promises delivery 1 quarter after ordering. Both cards can only sit side by side in Q1 2013, so both promise Q2 2013 here.

n06b.text: Odds from preorders.json: Summit Silicon 45/35/15/5 (never = 50% refund); group buy 40/35/18/7 (never = 40% refund). Going to a conference first moves 10 points into 'on time'.

n07.text: Net worth ≈ $3.9M per the brief: 3,900 BTC × $960 = $3.74M + $120K cash + machines ≈ $6K (3 ASICs and a GPU rig: what a 5 kW garage can hold). Mined = kept + sold + lost = 5,400 BTC. The career line's shape and the title 'The careful holder' are samples; the 2010-coins teaser figures are placeholders until the 2010 mining total is known.

n08.text: Everything carries over as it is. Sample machines and site match the chapter report. Prologue starts are ranked in Act I by growth multiple from this snapshot, not by absolute net worth.
